messages:
alex: Quick report: onboarding JS sampleapp + rust-retriever observed bad rerank after migrating to new embeddings endpoint. suspicion: batch helper parity + dim handling.

maya: what did the API return vs what SDKs parsed?

alex: API returned 2048-dim vectors (model changed mid-rollout). JS SDK parsed `data[0].embedding` correctly (2048). rust-retriever expects 1024 and the batcher.rs pads/truncates silently to 1024 during merge which skews cosine scores. Also the JS batch helper will pad with zeros when batch sizes differ. result: mixed-length vectors and non-deterministic ranks.

sam: any auth/retry noise? those can cause dupes.

ops-bot: [1725001240] 401 -> refresh -> 200 for POST /v1/embeddings request-id=abc-123

tori: yep we had a token-refresh + retry. In rust path the retry re-merged into an in-flight batch and triggered the truncate codepath; JS retried as separate request which created duplicate rows in the in-memory candidate list.

maya: can you paste minimal logs?

alex: log excerpt:
```text
2024-04-05T12:01:23Z caller=batcher.rs level=info batch_id=42 received 8 requests expected_dim=1024
2024-04-05T12:01:24Z caller=auth level=warn 401 for /v1/embeddings token_expired
2024-04-05T12:01:25Z caller=auth level=info token refresh ok
2024-04-05T12:01:25Z caller=batcher.rs level=info retry merge batch_id=42 real_dim=2048 -> truncating to 1024
2024-04-05T12:01:26Z caller=rerank level=info computed cosine for id=xyz score=0.12
```

sam: concrete fixes: 1) fail-fast if real_dim != expected_dim (opt-in flag for permissive workloads), 2) in batcher, preserve raw vectors until validation step, 3) require idempotency-key header on retries so retried requests are deduped before DB insert/merge.

tori: agreed. also standardize the response shape across SDKs: always expose `embedding` (single) and `embeddings` (batch) fields and document in onboarding.

maya: I'll land a small sampleapp patch for JS to validate dims and to set Idempotency-Key. sam/tori can land patch for rust.

alex: workaround snippet for teams who hit this now (JS):
```js
// shrinkwrap check
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({input: text});
const vec = resp?.data?.[0]?.embedding || resp?.data?.[0]?.vector;
if (!vec || vec.length !== CONFIG.EXPECTED_DIM) throw new Error(`bad dim ${vec?.length}`);
// set idempotency
client.defaults.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = reqId;
```

sam: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/98 (js: strict-dim-check) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/retriever-rs/pull/13 (rust: defer-validate-preserve-raw).

ops-bot: [1725001280] CI: sample-apps CI passed for PR#98 (4/4)

maya: I'll add a short FAQ in devex onboarding about model dim changes and how to set EXPECTED_DIM in sampleapps. also adding unit tests for these field-name variations and batching retry flows.

alex: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4301 label=devex/embeddings

ops-bot: [1725001288] noted. moving to follow-up backlog.

maya: great teamwork, shipping the immediate SDK/docs fixes today. :shipit:
